test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
The following bar graph shows the income and the expenditure (in lakh Rs.) of five families in the year 2021.

What is the savings of families A, C and E together?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c70b66b77d03558bb577b5104d069463ecdce16eb8a894713b76ac1690e7adab.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

Saving of family A = 25 - 12 = 13

Saving of family C = 18 - 10 = 8

Saving of family E = 10 - 9 = 1

Savings of families A, C and E together = 13 + 8 + 1 = Rs. 22 lakhs

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
